note: Data mentah hasil pembacaan kode passives/ dan divalidasi dengan menjalankan class aslinya (quality 0/50/100). Bukan data resmi OwO; angka bisa berubah bila upstream berubah.

formula.quality: quality 0-100, di-roll acak per stat saat senjata dibuat

passives.name: Strength
passives.summary: Menambah STR sebesar persen dari STR dasar.
passives.sourceText: Increases your STR by **?%**

passives.name: Magic
passives.summary: Menambah MAG sebesar persen dari MAG dasar.
passives.sourceText: Increases your MAG by **?%**

passives.name: Health Point
passives.summary: Menambah HP maksimum sebesar persen dari HP dasar.
passives.sourceText: Increases your HP by **?%**

passives.name: Weapon Point
passives.summary: Menambah WP maksimum sebesar persen dari WP dasar.
passives.sourceText: Increases your WP by **?%**

passives.name: Physical Resistance
passives.summary: Menambah PR sebesar persen dari PR dasar.
passives.sourceText: Increases your PR by **?%**

passives.name: Magical Resistance
passives.summary: Menambah MR sebesar persen dari MR dasar.
passives.sourceText: Increases your MR by **?%**

passives.name: Lifesteal
passives.summary: Setiap damage yang diberikan menyerap HP sebesar persen dari damage itu.
passives.sourceText: All damage you deal heals you for **?%** of the damage dealt!

passives.name: Thorns
passives.summary: Membalas persen damage yang diterima sebagai TRUE damage (tembus resistensi).
passives.sourceText: Reflect **?**% of the damage dealt to you as true damage

passives.name: Mana Tap
passives.summary: Setiap damage yang diberikan mengisi WP sebesar persen dari damage itu.
passives.sourceText: All damage you deal replenishes yourWPWP for **?%** of the damage dealt!

passives.name: Absolve
passives.summary: Saat menerima heal, menyerang satu musuh acak sebesar persen dari jumlah heal, sebagai MAG.
passives.sourceText: When healed, deal **?%** of the healed amount to a random enemy as MAG damage

passives.name: Safeguard
passives.summary: Membatalkan persen damage masuk dengan membakar WP sebanyak itu (WP habis = batal sebagian).
passives.sourceText: Negate **?**% of the damage dealt to you with WP

passives.name: Critical
passives.summary: Setiap serangan punya persen peluang menambah persen damage. Juga berlaku untuk heal.
passives.sourceText: Every attack has a **?%** chance to deal **?%** more damage. This can apply to heals.

passives.name: Discharge
passives.summary: Saat WP terisi, menyerang satu musuh acak sebesar persen dari jumlah WP yang terisi, sebagai MAG.
passives.sourceText: When WP is replenished, deal **?%** of the replenished amount to a random enemy as MAG damage

passives.name: Kamikaze
passives.summary: Saat mati, menyerang pembunuhnya sebesar persen HP maksimum sebagai MAG.
passives.sourceText: When the animal dies, deal **?%** of its max HP as MAG dmg to the attacker

passives.name: Regeneration
passives.summary: Memulihkan persen HP maksimum setiap akhir turn.
passives.sourceText: Heal **?%** of your maxHPHP after every turn

passives.name: Energize
passives.summary: Mengisi WP sejumlah nilai tetap setiap akhir turn.
passives.sourceText: Replenish **?** WP after every turn

passives.name: Sprout
passives.summary: Semua heal yang diterima bertambah persen.
passives.sourceText: Increase all incoming healing by **?%**

passives.name: Enrage
passives.summary: Setiap 10% HP yang hilang memberi tambahan persen damage.
passives.sourceText: Every 10% of missing health gives**?%** damage

passives.name: Sacrifice
passives.summary: Saat mati, menyembuhkan rekan tim persen HP maks dan mengisi persen WP maks mereka.
passives.sourceText: When this animal dies, heal your teammates for **?%** of its Max HP and replenish for **?%** of its Max WP

passives.name: Snail
passives.summary: Setiap menyerang, siput memukul musuh acak sebesar persen damage yang diberikan (abaikan resistensi).
passives.sourceText: Your pet snail fights with you. Whenever you attack an animal, snail will slap a random enemy for **?%** of the damage dealt.

passives.name: Knowledge
passives.summary: Tidak berefek di battle. Memberi persen XP ekstra setelah battle.
passives.sourceText: This passive does not do anything in battle. However, it will give this animal **?%** extra xp after each battle.
